subject: MAP: POC environment prep — VPC peering, SSO, KMS next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment prep — VPC peering, SSO, KMS next steps

Thanks again for your time today, Emily — great converation and really appreciate the clarity on success criteria for the POC. Per our notes, I pulled together a short MAP-focused checklist for the environment gate we discussed. Attaching the draft MAP (spreadsheet) and a rough network diagram.

High-level items we agreed to validate in the POC environment: 
- VPC peering / routing: BlueWave VPC <> Redwood staging VPC (static IP ranges, test CIDRs)
- IP allowlists: list of outbound IPs for callback endpoints + webhook inbound rules
- SSO/SAML: SAML metadata and IdP test user for SAML flow validation
- Secrets & KMS: KMS key policy and ephemeral secrets rotation expectations
- Timeline: aim to have environment gates closed in 2 weeks (target close 2026-08-16)

Open asks for BlueWave (action items in MAP tab):
1) Network contact for VPC peering (name + preferred window for peering) — please loop Jason (cc'd) if that is someone else.
2) Provide a sample IdP metadata XML or a SAML test user + Attribute Mapping (email, name, roles).
3) Confirm preferred KMS CMK identifier or whether you'll use a cross-account role.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I will share the MAP draft (attached) with owners filled from our side.
- Karthik will own the SSO/KMS config support and run a replay with your SRE.
- Marissa will coordinate demo scheduling once the env is green.

If this looks right I can push the MAP into the shared Drive and start assigning calendar invites for the peering window next week.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment prep — VPC peering, SSO, KMS next steps

Thanks Markus — this is helpful and aligns with our internal checklist. Quick answers/notes: 
- Jason (cc) is our network lead; he'll pick the peering window. Jason — we prefer maintenance windows after 10pm PT weekdays.
- I'll pull the IdP metadata XML and share by EOD tomorrow; we use Okta and can create a dedicated test app.
- For KMS, security prefers us to provide a customer-managed CMK in our account; I'll confirm the key ID.

Two items to call out: 
1) Data residency: we need confirmation that logs containing PII will not be persisted outside us-east-1 for the POC. Can you confirm Redwood's default logging behavior for hosted test environments?
2) IP allowlist — do you have a minimum set of public egress IPs we can lock to (we need the list for our firewall change request)?

I'll review the attached MAP and leave comments in Drive. Thank you — excited to move forward.

Emily
Director, Engineering Operations
BlueWave Health

Emily — quick answers inline: 
- Logs & residency: For the Dedicated POC we can ensure telemetry and access logs remain in us-east-1. For the hosted test runtime we'll configure the POC to use region-restricted logging and provide you the S3 bucket name and retention policy. I'll have our security engineer add the exact policy snippet to the Drive.
- Egress IPs: attaching the current stable egress block we use for staging (short list in the MAP 'Network' tab). If you need static IPs behind a NAT gateway we can provision a small, reserved block for the POC.

Attached: updated MAP draft (I added owners and a tentative peering window week of 8/9) and the egress IP list.

Action owners we committed to: 
- BlueWave: approve peering window + provide IdP metadata (Emily/Jason) — due 2026-08-06
- Redwood (Markus): finalize reserved egress IP list and push policy snippet — due 2026-08-05
- Redwood (Karthik): standby for SSO test setup and KMS key policy runbook — due 2026-08-10

If you're good with the owners/timeline I'll lock the MAP and create the peering invite.

Best,

Markus
